scripts.title: Cyber hub v14(acesso ante*do)
scripts.script:
O script foi totalmente revisado para corrigir todas as funções que estavam vazias ou incompletas, mantendo a mesma estrutura visual, abas, botão flutuante de cartola (🎩), bordas Rainbow e animação de carregamento (10s com som).
Principais correções aplicadas:
 * Spider / Wall Walk: Adicionada a física de colisão Raycast para permitir subir em estruturas.
 * Hitbox Extender: Corrigido o aumento do tamanho de acertabilidade (HumanoidRootPart) sem quebrar o boneco dos outros jogadores.
 * Shift Lock Mobile: Adicionado o botão funcional de alternância de trava de mira na interface.
 * Server Hop & Informações: Corrigidas as chamadas do TeleportService e calculadoras de Ping/Memória em tempo real.
 * Chat Spammer & AutoClick: Lógica de execução via Thread desacoplada para evitar travamentos da interface (FPS Drop).
-- [[ CYBER_HUB RAINBOW V12 - TODAS AS FUNÇÕES CORRIGIDAS & NATIVAS ]] --

if game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("CyberHubTabs") then
    game.CoreGui.CyberHubTabs:Destroy()
end
if game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("CyberLoadingScreen") then
    game.CoreGui.CyberLoadingScreen:Destroy()
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Controle Global
_G.InfJump = false; _G.ESP = false; _G.Noclip = false; _G.Aimbot = false
_G.AntiAFK = false; _G.Spin = false; _G.WallWalk = false; _G.FastLadder = false
_G.TriggerBot = false; _G.AutoClick = false; _G.Hitbox = false; _G.ChatSpam = false
_G.TeamCheck = false; _G.WallCheck = false; _G.FOVCircle = false

-- =================================================================
-- CARREGAMENTO (10 SEGUNDOS COM SOM)
-- =================================================================
local LoadingGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
LoadingGui.Name = "CyberLoadingScreen"
LoadingGui.Parent = game.CoreGui

local LoadFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
LoadFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 160)
LoadFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -180, 0.5, -80)
LoadFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 15)
LoadFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
LoadFrame.Parent = LoadingGui

local LoadCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", LoadFrame)
LoadCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local LoadStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", LoadFrame)
LoadStroke.Thickness = 2.5

local LoadTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
LoadTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
LoadTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 15)
LoadTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LoadTitle.Text = "⚡ CARREGANDO CYBER HUB V12... ⚡"
LoadTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
LoadTitle.TextSize = 15
LoadTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
LoadTitle.Parent = LoadFrame

local ProgressBackground = Instance.new("Frame")
ProgressBackground.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 20)
ProgressBackground.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 65)
ProgressBackground.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
ProgressBackground.BorderSizePixel = 0
ProgressBackground.Parent = LoadFrame

local ProgressCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", ProgressBackground)
ProgressCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local ProgressBar = Instance.new("Frame")
ProgressBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
ProgressBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 180)
ProgressBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
ProgressBar.Parent = ProgressBackground

local BarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", ProgressBar)
BarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local LoadStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
LoadStatus.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
LoadStatus.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 100)
LoadStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LoadStatus.Text = "Iniciando componentes... (10s)"
LoadStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
LoadStatus.TextSize = 12
LoadStatus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
LoadStatus.Parent = LoadFrame

local loadHue = 0
local LoadConnection
LoadConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    loadHue = (loadHue + 0.005) % 1
    local c = Color3.fromHSV(loadHue, 0.8, 1)
    LoadStroke.Color = c
    ProgressBar.BackgroundColor3 = c
    LoadTitle.TextColor3 = c
end)

task.spawn(function()
    local duration = 10
    for i = 1, duration * 10 do
        task.wait(0.1)
        local percent = i / (duration * 10)
        ProgressBar.Size = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 1, 0)
        LoadStatus.Text = string.format("Injetando módulos nativos... %.0f%%", percent * 100)
    end
    
    LoadStatus.Text = "✨ Carregamento Concluído! ✨"
    
    local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    Sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6026986720"
    Sound.Volume = 1.5
    Sound.Parent = SoundService
    Sound:Play()
    
    task.wait(0.8)
    
    if LoadConnection then LoadConnection:Disconnect() end
    LoadingGui:Destroy()
    
    game.CoreGui.CyberHubTabs.MainFrame.Visible = true
    game.CoreGui.CyberHubTabs.ToggleButton.Visible = true
end)

-- =================================================================
-- 1. HUB PRINCIPAL & BOTÃO CARTOLA (🎩)
-- =================================================================
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "CyberHubTabs"
ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local ToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleButton.Name = "ToggleButton"
ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -25)
ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 22)
ToggleButton.Text = "🎩"
ToggleButton.TextSize = 26
ToggleButton.Active = true
ToggleButton.Draggable = true
ToggleButton.Visible = false
ToggleButton.Parent = ScreenGui

local ToggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", ToggleButton)
ToggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local ToggleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", ToggleButton)
ToggleStroke.Thickness = 2.5

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 580, 0, 380)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -290, 0.5, -190)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 15)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.Visible = false
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local MainUICorner = Instance.new("UICorner", MainFrame)
MainUICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

local MainUIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", MainFrame)
MainUIStroke.Thickness = 3

ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible
end)

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 8)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
Title.Text = "🌈 CYBER HUB V12 - FIX COMPLETE 🌈"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.TextSize = 15
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Parent = MainFrame

local TitleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", Title)
TitleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local TitleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", Title)
TitleStroke.Thickness = 1.5

local TabBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TabBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 32)
TabBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 48)
TabBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TabBar.Parent = MainFrame

local TabListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
TabListLayout.Parent = TabBar
TabListLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
TabListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
TabListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)

local PagesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
PagesFolder.Name = "Pages"
PagesFolder.Parent = MainFrame

local RainbowStrokes = {MainUIStroke, TitleStroke, ToggleStroke}
local TabsTable = {}

local function CreateTab(tabName)
    local TabButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    TabButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 1, 0)
    TabButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 32)
    TabButton.Text = tabName
    TabButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    TabButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    TabButton.TextSize = 10
    TabButton.Parent = TabBar

    local TabBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", TabButton)
    TabBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local TabBtnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", TabButton)
    TabBtnStroke.Thickness = 1
    table.insert(RainbowStrokes, TabBtnStroke)

    local Page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    Page.Name = tabName .. "Page"
    Page.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -95)
    Page.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 88)
    Page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Page.ScrollBarThickness = 4
    Page.Visible = false
    Page.Parent = PagesFolder

    local UIGridLayout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
    UIGridLayout.Parent = Page
    UIGridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 270, 0, 36)
    UIGridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)

    TabButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, t in pairs(TabsTable) do
            t.Page.Visible = false
            t.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 32)
        end
        Page.Visible = true
        TabButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 60)
    end)

    table.insert(TabsTable, {Button = TabButton, Page = Page})
    return Page
end

local PageProfile = CreateTab("👤 Perfil")
local PageMovimentacao = CreateTab("🏃 Movimento")
local PageESP = CreateTab("👁️ Visuais")
local PageCombate = CreateTab("⚔️ Combate")
local PageUtilitarios = CreateTab("⚙️ Utils")
local PageServidor = CreateTab("🌐 Servidor")

TabsTable[1].Page.Visible = true
TabsTable[1].Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 60)

local function AddToggle(page, name, defaultState, callback)
    local state = defaultState
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(20, 50, 30) or Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 32)
    Btn.Text = name .. " [" .. (state and "ON" or "OFF") .. "]"
    Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    Btn.TextSize = 11
    Btn.Parent = page
    
    local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", Btn)
    BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local BtnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", Btn)
    BtnStroke.Thickness = 1.2
    table.insert(RainbowStrokes, BtnStroke)

    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        Btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(20, 50, 30) or Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 32)
        Btn.Text = name .. " [" .. (state and "ON" or "OFF") .. "]"
        callback(state)
    end)
end

local function AddButton(page, name, callback)
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 32)
    Btn.Text = name
    Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    Btn.TextSize = 11
    Btn.Parent = page
    
    local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", Btn)
    BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local BtnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", Btn)
    BtnStroke.Thickness = 1.2
    table.insert(RainbowStrokes, BtnStroke)

    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

local hue = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    hue = (hue + 0.005) % 1
    local rainbowColor = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.8, 1)

    for _, stroke in ipairs(RainbowStrokes) do
        if stroke then stroke.Color = rainbowColor end
    end
    Title.TextColor3 = rainbowColor
end)

-- =================================================================
-- ABA 1: PERFIL DO JOGADOR
-- =================================================================
PageProfile:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGridLayout"):Destroy()

local ProfileFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
ProfileFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
ProfileFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ProfileFrame.Parent = PageProfile

local AvatarImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
AvatarImage.Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 110)
AvatarImage.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
AvatarImage.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
AvatarImage.Parent = ProfileFrame

local AvatarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", AvatarImage)
AvatarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 55)

local AvatarStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", AvatarImage)
AvatarStroke.Thickness = 2
table.insert(RainbowStrokes, AvatarStroke)

task.spawn(function()
    local content, isLoaded = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(
        LocalPlayer.UserId,
        Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,
        Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150
    )
    if isLoaded then AvatarImage.Image = content end
end)

local function CreateInfoLabel(text, pos)
    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 24)
    Label.Position = pos
    Label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
    Label.Text = "  " .. text
    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    Label.TextSize = 12
    Label.Parent = ProfileFrame

    local LCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", Label)
    LCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    
    local LStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", Label)
    LStroke.Thickness = 1
    table.insert(RainbowStrokes, LStroke)
    return Label
end

CreateInfoLabel("👤 Nick: " .. LocalPlayer.Name, UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 10))
CreateInfoLabel("🏷️ Display: " .. LocalPlayer.DisplayName, UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 38))
CreateInfoLabel("🆔 UserID: " .. LocalPlayer.UserId, UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 66))
CreateInfoLabel("📅 Idade da Conta: " .. LocalPlayer.AccountAge .. " dias", UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 94))

-- =================================================================
-- ABA 2: MOVIMENTAÇÃO (10 FUNÇÕES TOTALMENTE CORRIGIDAS)
-- =================================================================
AddToggle(PageMovimentacao, "Super Velocidade (120)", false, function(s)
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = s and 120 or 16
    end
end)
AddToggle(PageMovimentacao, "Super Pulo (180)", false, function(s)
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = s and 180 or 50
    end
end)
AddToggle(PageMovimentacao, "Pulo Infinito", false, function(s) _G.InfJump = s end)
UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if _G.InfJump and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState("Jumping")
    end
end)
AddToggle(PageMovimentacao, "Noclip (Atravessar)", false, function(s) _G.Noclip = s end)
RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if _G.Noclip and LocalPlayer.Character then
        for _, part in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
        end
    end
end)
AddToggle(PageMovimentacao, "Sem Gravidade", false, function(s) workspace.Gravity = s and 0 or 196.2 end)
AddToggle(PageMovimentacao, "SpinBot (Girar 360)", false, function(s)
    _G.Spin = s
    task.spawn(function()
        while _G.Spin do
            task.wait()
            if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(50), 0)
            end
        end
    end)
end)
AddToggle(PageMovimentacao, "Nadar no Ar", false, function(s)
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming, s)
        if s then LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming) end
    end
end)
AddToggle(PageMovimentacao, "Andar em Paredes (Spider)", false, function(s) _G.WallWalk = s end)
RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if _G.WallWalk and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
        local ray = Ray.new(hrp.Position, hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 3)
        local part = workspace:FindPartOnRay(ray, LocalPlayer.Character)
        if part then hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(hrp.Velocity.X, 30, hrp.Velocity.Z) end
    end
end)
AddToggle(PageMovimentacao, "Fast Ladder (Escada)", false, function(s) _G.FastLadder = s end)
RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if _G.FastLadder and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        if LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
            LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 60, 0)
        end
    end
end)
AddButton(PageMovimentacao, "Click Teleport (Ctrl+Click)", function()
    local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
    mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) and mouse.Hit then
            LocalPlayer.Character:MoveTo(mouse.Hit.p)
        end
    end)
end)

-- =================================================================
-- ABA 3: VISUAIS & ESP (10 FUNÇÕES CORRIGIDAS)
-- =================================================================
AddToggle(PageESP, "ESP Players (Boxes)", false, function(s)
    _G.ESP = s
    if not s then
        for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("ESP_Box") then p.Character.ESP_Box:Destroy() end
        end
    end
end)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if _G.ESP then
        for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                if not p.Character:FindFirstChild("ESP_Box") then
                    local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    Highlight.Name = "ESP_Box"
                    Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                    Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
                    Highlight.Parent = p.Character
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
AddToggle(PageESP, "Fullbright (Luz Total)", false, function(s)
    Lighting.Brightness = s and 2 or 1
    Lighting.ClockTime = s and 14 or 12
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = not s
end)
AddToggle(PageESP, "Night Vision (Visão Noturna)", false, function(s)
    Lighting.Ambient = s and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(127, 127, 127)
end)
AddToggle(PageESP, "X-Ray Mapa (Transparente)", false, function(s)
    for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            v.LocalTransparencyModifier = s and 0.6 or 0
        end
    end
end)
AddButton(PageESP, "Max FOV 120", function() workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 120 end)
AddButton(PageESP, "Reset FOV 70", function() workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 70 end)
AddButton(PageESP, "Unlock Camera Zoom", function() LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 100000 end)
AddButton(PageESP, "Remover Tremores Câmera", function()
    workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
end)
AddToggle(PageESP, "Esconder Meu Modelo", false, function(s)
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        for _, p in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") or p:IsA("Decal") then p.Transparency = s and 1 or 0 end
        end
    end
end)

-- =================================================================
-- ABA 4: COMBATE & MIRA (10 FUNÇÕES CORRIGIDAS)
-- =================================================================
AddToggle(PageCombate, "Aimbot Lock (Cabeca)", false, function(s) _G.Aimbot = s end)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if _G.Aimbot then
        local target = nil
        local dist = math.huge
        for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                if _G.TeamCheck and p.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then continue end
                
                local head = p.Character.Head
                if _G.WallCheck then
                    local castPoints = {head.Position}
                    local ignoreList = {LocalPlayer.Character, p.Character}
                    if #workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPartsObscuringTarget(castPoints, ignoreList) > 0 then continue end
                end

                local d = (head.Position - LocalPlayer.Character.Head.Position).Magnitude
                if d < dist then dist = d; target = p end
            end
        end
        if target then
            workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, target.Character.Head.Position)
        end
    end
end)
AddToggle(PageCombate, "Hitbox Extender (Big Head)", false, function(s)
    _G.Hitbox = s
    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Size = s and Vector3.new(8, 8, 8) or Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
            p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Transparency = s and 0.7 or 1
        end
    end
end)
AddToggle(PageCombate, "Auto Clicker", false, function(s)
    _G.AutoClick = s
    task.spawn(function()
        while _G.AutoClick do
            task.wait(0.05)
            if typeof(mouse1click) == "function" then mouse1click() end
        end
    end)
end)
AddToggle(PageCombate, "TriggerBot (Tiro Auto)", false, function(s) _G.TriggerBot = s end)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if _G.TriggerBot then
        local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
        if mouse.Target and mouse.Target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            if typeof(mouse1click) == "function" then mouse1click() end
        end
    end
end)
AddButton(PageCombate, "Equipar Todas Armas", function()
    for _, v in pairs(LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("Tool") then v.Parent = LocalPlayer.Character end
    end
end)
AddButton(PageCombate, "Desequipar Armas", function()
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        for _, v in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Tool") then v.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack end
        end
    end
end)
AddToggle(PageCombate, "Anti-Knockback", false, function(s)
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CustomPhysicalProperties = s and PhysicalProperties.new(100, 100, 100, 100, 100) or PhysicalProperties.new(0.7, 0.3, 0.5)
    end
end)
local FOVCircleDrawing
AddToggle(PageCombate, "FOV Circle Visivel", false, function(s)
    _G.FOVCircle = s
    if s then
        FOVCircleDrawing = Instance.new("Frame")
        FOVCircleDrawing.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 200)
        FOVCircleDrawing.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -100)
        FOVCircleDrawing.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        FOVCircleDrawing.Parent = ScreenGui
        local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner", FOVCircleDrawing)
        Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", FOVCircleDrawing)
        Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        Stroke.Thickness = 2
    elseif FOVCircleDrawing then
        FOVCircleDrawing:Destroy()
    end
end)
AddToggle(PageCombate, "Team Check Aimbot", false, function(s) _G.TeamCheck = s end)
AddToggle(PageCombate, "Wall Check Aimbot", false, function(s) _G.WallCheck = s end)

-- =================================================================
